summary: An editable browser board now supports dragging one root by its grip before or after a sibling. store::reorder_group_item owns the order: under current write access it checks the board and item revisions, ranks the whole group, and commits positions, field stamps and the operation receipt together. The preview keeps the accepted rows visible while saving and reads the board after acknowledgment.
evidence: browser_reorders_duplicate_rows_by_pointer passed in owned headless Chromium. Short travel, Escape after a visible marker, self, cross-group and outside drops sent no write. With the board locked, a repeat gesture did not submit another request. Dropping 67 before 61 produced one POST 200 and one grouped GET: 73@0,67@1,61@2,77@3. Reload resolved the session and read the same history entry without replay. A fresh drop below 61 persisted 73@0,61@1,67@2,77@3 across another reload.

Fresh connections compared the grouped and flat order, all item records including archived, sibling-board and direct-target rows, all board revisions and groups, receipts, grants, role and original session. Counts stayed 4/0/1. Only board 201 and item 67 advanced to revisions 2 and 3, with both selected field stamps advancing and one distinct receipt per commit. These outcomes match the recorded packet 34 reference fixture.

browser_demoted_viewer_cannot_reorder passed. Demotion with the edge marked yielded one POST 403 and a grouped GET 200. The current board and reloaded board had no grips, the Viewer gesture sent nothing, and storage retained the original order and no receipt.

browser_failed_reorder_rolls_back_then_redrags passed. A schema-local deferred receipt trigger failed at commit (500). The marker cleared; the table retained its rows and offered Reload board. Reconnect before fault removal confirmed no position, revision, stamp or receipt changes. Reload only read; a deliberate new drop committed once and survived reload.

preview_reorder_requires_current_access_and_anchor passed for session rejection, Viewer, withdrawn membership, inactive/missing/foreign records, self and misplaced anchors, invalid side, unexpected position and nonpositive revisions. Moving the anchor after the read produced 409. The direct, native and non-preview paths exposed no reorder. Independent reads found no effects after each refusal.

preview_reorder_checks_revisions_and_replay passed. Migrating populated v5 twice preserved the tied rows and provenance. Two preview host connections raced different operations at one board revision: one committed, one conflicted. Exact retransmission on the other connection returned the same acknowledgment; changed content, a different actor, stale board/item revisions and an old group-edit baseline failed. A sibling rename from its original baseline succeeded.

Full serial browser_preview suite: 20 passed, including all 17 inherited journeys. Locked workspace tests: 34 passed, including all 19 loopback_board_access cases. Cargo used target-browser-packets. Workspace formatting and git diff --check passed. The worker shell denied node --test scripts/run.test.mjs before execution; Node runner regressions remain for coordinator verification. Malformed acknowledgment, failed post-commit refresh and superseded-visit responses were not separately fault-injected in Chromium.
